title: Redact Secret implementation-ready handoff v1
description: The machine-readable form of an implementation-ready issue. It carries identifiers, links, grammars described in words, and command lines, never a credential value, never benchmark corpus content, and never a support status. A file that validates says the issue body is complete enough to start coding; it does not say the family is supported.

issue.description: The core implementation issue this handoff belongs to. One issue, one handoff; research and implementation are never one issue.

state.description: The work-item state this file claims. Only implementation-ready has a handoff payload; the other four states carry nothing to validate.

family.description: Taxonomy id (provider:family) from the benchmarks taxonomy, or a core-owned contextual or PII family id.

detector.description: Detector id the change lands in. Required unless route is fixture-only; a new detector names the id it will take.

findingTypes.description: Finding kinds the change adds or changes (snake_case). Empty only for fixture-only.

task.description: Section 1 of the issue body: one task a contributor can read cold.

positives.description: Section 2: supported shapes and contexts, in words or character classes. No literal that matches a real credential.

exclusions.description: Section 3a: explicit exclusions, including every unresolved limitation (a gated body, an undocumented length). Nothing gated is inside the supported contract.

twins.description: Section 3b: near-miss twins and benign siblings the implementation must not flag, each with the reason it is a control.

policy.description: Policy classification. Detection stays separate from enforcement: this states the default the product contract adopted, not a new enforcement mechanism.

fixturesRequired.description: Fixture groups the PR adds to the shared corpus.

bindingsEquivalent.description: The equivalence harness across bindings must stay green (true for any detector change).

syntheticOnly.description: Fixture values are built at run time from repeated filler or are unmistakably synthetic; never a realistic key literal.

research.description: Section 6 (maintainer evidence): the revision-bound research handoff and the core adoption ruling. The implementer does not need to read these to start.

readAt.description: The 40-hex commit of the research source the handoff was read at.

adoption.description: Where core adopted the supported/excluded contract (an issue comment or ADR link) and the date.

limitations.description: Unresolved limitations, each restated as an exclusion above and gated here by what is missing.

evaluation.description: Independent evaluation linkage. Implementation-ready is a coding handoff and carries no support verdict; these fields only name who measures next.

benchmarkIssue.description: The redact-secret-benchmarks issue that will measure the exact candidate (the reverse handoff target).

supportStatus.description: Always the literal separate: promotion and stable support are derived by benchmarks from measured evidence and are never written here.

surfaces.description: Section 4: files or surfaces likely to change (paths or globs; a hint, not a limit).

commands.description: Section 5: exact scoped local checks, run from the repository root.

description.description: A shape or context in words or a character-class grammar. Quote only provider-documented prefixes. Never a complete credential-shaped literal.

permalink.description: A past-state citation: a 40-hex commit permalink into redact-secret, credential-evidence or redact-secret-benchmarks.
